_doc: Employee roles. wage = pounds per hour at skill 3 (scaled 0.8..1.25 by skill 1..5). rate = work per hour at skill 3.

cashier.name: Cashier
cashier.desc: Serves the till: customers never wait for you.

stocker.name: Shelf Stacker
stocker.desc: Fills shelves from the back room.

manager.name: Store Manager
manager.desc: Runs the shop when you're away: re-orders stock (delivered), opens and closes, tells you when something's wrong.

driver.name: Delivery Driver
driver.desc: Collects wholesale orders in a company van: no delivery fee.

friendly.name: Friendly
friendly.effect: + reputation from every sale they make.
